integrity: Proved statements are distinguished from finite exact enumeration. The exceptional counts are supported by explicit profile enumeration, exact factorial weights and a separate adjacency-level exhaustive implementation; no authorship or independent review is claimed.
limitations: Claim concerns only crown graphs with at least three vertices per side; not arbitrary deletions of matchings.
For the six-cycle the scalar total coalition number was established previously; only its counted partitions are included here.
No claim of global priority against unindexed literature or independent external certification.
title: Total coalition partitions of crown graphs: a four-vertex deficit and an exact optimum census
